Follow-up to v0.1.70, from what the first hosted session on it reported.

## Server

### Fixed
- The inventory owner id now goes on through the same table patch the player-record save already uses. On a live host the per-field writes never landed on the inventory parameter, while the sibling player-record save reported `table_ok=true` on the very same saves, so one path works on this build and the other never did. The inventory stamp now takes that path too when the field writes come back empty.

### Changed
- The stamp reports `table_ok` alongside `changed` and `struct_ok`, so which of the two routes carried the write is visible rather than inferred.
- v0.1.70's mangled-name lookup stays, but the first host to run it answered the question it was asking: the inventory parameter does not support property enumeration at all on this build, so that lookup cannot fire here. It is left in place for builds that do expose it, and it is not what fixes this.
